text:
I went today for the “Migraine Massage Program and Cupping Package” (1,590 THB) and it was a very disappointing experience.

When I arrived, the staff seemed stressed because they did not have a therapist available, even though I booked several hours in advance and received confirmation. This should have been properly arranged beforehand. Instead, they brought in a freelance masseur. She was a very kind and lovely lady, but it was clear she was not fully trained or familiar with the specific procedures of this package, and several parts felt poorly executed.

The worst part was the environment. The package lasts 130 minutes, and during that time there were maybe 10 minutes of silence. Staff were talking loudly, laughing, using their phones, and watching videos throughout the session. It was extremely disruptive and completely ruined any chance of relaxation — especially unacceptable for a migraine-focused treatment.

A wellness or massage center should prioritize calm, professionalism, and preparation. Unfortunately, this experience felt disorganized, noisy, and not worth the price.

I would not recommend this place for anyone seeking relaxation or migraine relief
